mike_support: Customer NovaPay (acct: NP-435) reports recurring 429s in EU prod starting ~03:00 UTC. They see short bursts lasting ~30–90s that coincide with their hourly token refresh job. They included one sample request_id: rq_0a9f3c. Can we triage?

anya_prod_oncall: thx mike. Can you ask for a small repro (curl) and the full response headers for a 429? particularly x-ratelimit-* or any retry-after values. Also did they say TPM or RPM hitting?

mike_support: replied to customer, they sent this snippet: `X-RateLimit-Limit: 120; X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0; X-RateLimit-Reset: 1718304305` and `Retry-After: 8`. They think it's TPM but numbers unclear. Sending their curl now.

ellie_se: paste the curl here when you get it. quick thought — if their clients refresh auth tokens in lockstep across instances (top of hour), you'll see a synchronized spike as all workers re-auth then replay requests. different cause than steady high concurrency.

raj_infra: +1. Also check whether they use our client SDK with token cache disabled or a short-lived oauth flow that triggers reauth for all threads. If everyone pauses for 200ms to refresh and then sends queued requests, that creates a microburst that hits per-minute windows.

mike_support: customer curl: `for i in {1..300}; do curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":16}' & done` run every 3600s. They said 40 instances run this at the same cron.

tim_engr: that loop + 40 instances explains it. 300 reqs * 40 = 12k requests in a short window. If their per-minute quota is O(10000) or lower, you'll get transient 429 storms. Two quick mitigations: 1) advise client to add jitter to the cron (randomize start within the hour), 2) switch to a token bucket smoothing approach client-side (spread the 300 calls across the minute).

anya_prod_oncall: infra checks — can we find the server-side rate drop logs around the rq_0a9f3c id? I want to confirm whether requests were throttled by RPM window or concurrent burst protection.

raj_infra: pulled logs: multiple 429 events for rq_0a9f3c and neighbors, all flagged as "rate_limit_exceeded.v2" with reason="burst_window". Our metrics show spike at 03:00:05 UTC, 45s duration, peak 11.8k rps-> (note: rps/sec) then back to baseline. Headers show `X-RateLimit-Type: window` and `X-RateLimit-Window: minute`.

ellie_se: reply to customer with minimal repro guidance: 1) add `sleep $((RANDOM % 60))` before the loop to spread, 2) set concurrency to 10 and do controlled ramp up `seq 1 300 | xargs -P10 -I{} curl ...`, 3) capture headers `-i` for both 200s and 429s and paste back. Example snippet: 
```
# add jitter and limited parallelism
sleep $((RANDOM % 60))
for i in $(seq 1 300); do
  printf "payload %s" "$i" | xargs -P10 -I{} curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":16}'
  done
```

raj_infra: also note: if they need burst capacity for hourly batch jobs, we can offer a temporary quota bump or a scheduled burst window on Dedicated plans. For hosted customers, we can suggest staggering jobs or applying exponential backoff + jitter on 429s.

anya_prod_oncall: operational action: I opened internal ticket INF-2789 to flag burst_window throttles for NP-435 and attached the logs. I'll propose a 15-minute temporary quota increase to sales for account team to approve.

mike_support: shared instructions to NovaPay and asked them to run the jittered repro and paste headers. Customer asked whether token refresh timing matters — tl;dr yes.

devbot: deploy bot: "Notice: rate-limit-adjuster v1.3 deployed to control-plane at 2024-08-09T03:12:00Z"

tim_engr: FYI for engineering: we should add a short KB snippet showing how to interpret our x-ratelimit headers and best client patterns (jitter, smoothing, polite concurrency). Also consider a dashboard alert that surfaces synchronized auth/cron spikes per account.

mike_support: customer ran jittered test — they saw 200s with remaining>0 and occasional 429s much reduced. Customer happy to implement jitter. Will close after we confirm sales quota outcome. :thumbsup:
